title: GL-15 — CloudWatch and CloudTrail
stopChargesPanel: Stop trail, delete trail, empty bucket, delete alarm.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on CloudWatch and CloudTrail; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Set lab variables
bullets: Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.
Set `$Bucket = "workbook-gl15-$AccountId"`.
Success: date variables and lab names are set.

steps.title: Trail bucket
bullets: Run `aws s3api create-bucket --bucket $Bucket --region us-east-1`.
Run `aws s3api put-bucket-tagging --bucket $Bucket --tagging "TagSet=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-15},{Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab}]"`.
Success: bucket exists.

steps.title: Create trail
bullets: Run `aws cloudtrail create-trail --name workbook-gl15 --s3-bucket-name $Bucket --is-multi-region-trail`.
Run `aws cloudtrail start-logging --name workbook-gl15`.
Success: IsLogging is true.

steps.title: Generate activity
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: trail delivers an event within a few minutes.

steps.title: Put metric alarm
bullets: Run `aws cloudwatch put-metric-alarm --alarm-name workbook-gl15 --metric-name CPUUtilization --namespace AWS/EC2 --statistic Average --period 300 --threshold 80 --comparison-operator GreaterThanThreshold --evaluation-periods 1 --datapoints-to-alarm 1 --dimensions Name=InstanceId,Value=i-0123456789abcdef0 --alarm-actions []`.
Use a dummy InstanceId; this alarm is for practice only.
Success: alarm exists.

steps.title: Stop logging
bullets: Run `aws cloudtrail stop-logging --name workbook-gl15`.
Success: IsLogging is false.

steps.title: Delete trail
bullets: Run `aws cloudtrail delete-trail --name workbook-gl15`.
Success: trail is gone.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
Stopping an instance or scaling to zero is not teardown.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: CloudTrail, alarm, trail bucket objects, bucket
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-15` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources can still bill until deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-15 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-15 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-15. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: CloudTrail to S3 plus one CloudWatch alarm on an existing metric.
